title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR 5 — singular act enters by reatus, not substance
pass_a_gloss: GAR 5: A one-off deed cannot, as substance, be said to walk into another man; yet by reatus it may—because of that deed he is held guilty and so under penalties.
pass_b_english: GAR. 5. And so although a singular action, by reason of its substance, cannot be said to enter into another, yet by reason of reatus it is rightly said to enter, insofar as because of that action another is held guilty, and so lies under penalties.
source_text: GAR. 5. Itaque quamquam singularis actio, ratione substantiae suae non potest dici introire in alium, tamen ratione reatus introire recte dicitur, quatenus propter actionem illam alius reus habetur, adeoque poenis subiacet.

choices.choice: Act enters by reatus not substance
